title: Project Labyrinth is out now, I released my game out of early access, I'm at peace.
author: marcusmorga
selftext:
Started this game 1 year ago to date. I've given everything I can, and its a banger of a game. Its challenging. 

I didn't vibe code. I know yall like to vibe code. I more or less just got code from gpt at first, and claude much later for when I made things more complex, my enemy brains I made are pretty cool. 

But yea, game is fully playable, I think somebody more talented can do better. But I'm out of candle sticks to burn.

It should be on sale soon for fall steam sale.

I technically designed my own game engine within unity, as most if not all my scripts don't really use the same unity stuff, like for animations etc. It just made sense to me. I have a fully working cutscene manager, that anyone can use, it just turns objects on, moves things based on transforms, turns objects off, per "frame" or shot. Interesting stuff. 

I might put it all in one big ass folder and share it. Just gotta find the time to. 

My bosses are hard, like Souls hard, like bs hard. But fun, I only beat one of them in Act 2, and it wasn't the one I thought I was the easiest. Because it turns out, that one is actually hard.
